product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system tailored for physiotherapy clinics that merges traditional clinical management features with Artificial Intelligence assistance to optimize patient care, clinical documentation, and operational management.
core_goals: Digitize and automate physiotherapy clinical processes
Enhance clinical documentation quality using AI
Increase operational efficiency and patient satisfaction
key_features: Comprehensive Patient Management including full CRUD with validation, medical history, and document storage
Advanced Appointment Scheduling with weekly calendar, conflict prevention, recurrence, and multiple therapists
A rich Exercise Library with videos, filters, grouping, and difficulty levels
Protocol Management allowing customized treatment plans with exercises, intensities, and durations
Exercise Assignments supporting prescription and progress tracking
Progress Tracking dashboards featuring metrics and session tracking
Clinical Documentation (SOAP) with rich text editor, auto-save, templates, and version history
Interactive Body Map for pain assessment
AI-powered features integrated via Google Gemini AI for automatic report generation, treatment suggestions, risk analysis, and clinical queries
Comprehensive Financial Management including billing, payments with PIX integration, reports, and analytics
Detailed Reports and Analytics with export options and interactive dashboards
Multi-role Authentication and Authorization system built on Supabase
Dedicated Patient and Partner Portals for access to exercises, appointments, and communication
WhatsApp Integration for notifications and reminders
Inventory Management for equipment and supplies with low stock alerts
Automated Notification System and Logging for compliance and auditing
Reusable UI Component Library and robust Form Validation using Zod and React Hook Form
user_flow_summary: Administrator logs in via secure multi-role authentication to access dashboard, manage users, financials, inventory, and reports
Physiotherapist manages patients, schedules appointments, writes SOAP notes with AI assistance, assigns exercises and tracks progress
Patients access their portal to view prescribed exercises, schedule appointments, and communicate with clinic
Appointment booking system dynamically prevents scheduling conflicts and sends notifications to patients and therapists
Exercise assignment and progress tracking enable personalized rehabilitation plans
AI assistant generates clinical reports and treatment protocols aiding therapists' clinical decisions
Financial management tracks payments, manages subscriptions, and generates financial reports
Inventory alerts notify administrators of low stock and task management tracks clinic operational activities
validation_criteria: System validates input data including CPF to prevent duplicates and enforce data integrity
Appointment scheduling prevents conflicts and supports recurring events with notifications
SOAP note editor auto-saves content and maintains version history
AI integration generates accurate physiotherapeutic reports and treatment suggestions with over 95% precision
User role-based access control restricts permissions appropriately
Responsive UI renders correctly across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices
Performance targets include under 2 seconds page load on 3G and system uptime over 99.5%
Data encryption in transit and at rest complies with LGPD and security standards
Automated backups and audit logs are maintained for compliance and disaster recovery
Exported reports correctly generate in PDF/CSV formats and maintain data integrity
